notablePrerequisites: You control at least five additional nontoken creatures.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five additional nontoken creatures, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Cast Squee by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Squee.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Squee to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Squee in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Squee dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you have a sixth additional nontoken creature, sacrifice it as well each loop to get infinite colored mana.
